_owner: lead. IDs and order are frozen; owners may refine features/K inside schemas/heads/<name>.json (which they own).

heads.name: draft_pick
heads.candidates: available champion_draft picks (mask from the SDK draft state); candidate 0 = teacher pick
heads.teacher: original draft_net + map lineup logic (unchanged, model draft_net_original)

heads.name: strategy
heads.call_site: bot.cpp play_turn behaviour chain after handle_enemies() returned false
heads.frequency: strategy cadence (every turn that reaches the chain; cached context allowed)
heads.candidates: behaviour-first options: 0 = teacher order; farm, bank, home/regroup, hunt/contest, defend
heads.teacher: fixed priority chain tribute-win > go_home > hunt > tribute > farm

heads.name: objective
heads.call_site: bot.cpp score_groups/farm target selection (after the teacher has chosen)
heads.candidates: teacher's top-K scored camp groups; 0 = teacher choice

heads.name: role
heads.call_site: bot.cpp play_turn (strategy cadence); consumed as context by strategy/objective
heads.candidates: role set (teacher-implied role first): farmer, carrier, fighter, escort, scout

heads.name: bank
heads.call_site: bot.cpp tribute_if_needed / go_home_if_needed bank trigger + altar choice
heads.frequency: each turn the teacher evaluates the bank trigger while carrying gems
heads.candidates: 0 = teacher verdict (bank at teacher altar or continue); alternatives: opposite verdict, other reachable altars
heads.teacher: carry threshold tune::kTributeCarry, win_now, end-bank, safety logic

heads.name: shop
heads.frequency: each shop opportunity (on spawn, dead, Tavi remote)
heads.candidates: 0 = teacher purchase (or save); affordable legal items/consumables; save

heads.name: move
heads.candidates: legal endpoint tiles (and dash landings) from the deterministic generator; 0 = teacher endpoint
heads.teacher: distance-field descent, threat routing, escape search

heads.name: combat
heads.candidates: legal (ability, target) pairs in exact range/cooldown/resource; 0 = teacher action
heads.teacher: target scoring, burst kill, caster micro

heads.name: belief
heads.call_site: nn_obs (threat/intent estimates used as features by other heads; optional residual to World::expected_enemies)
heads.outputs: per-sector enemy presence logits + enemy intent summary

heads.name: value
heads.call_site: shared context (critic for training; optional planning signal)
heads.outputs: team win probability logit, expected final gem margin, carried-gem loss risk
heads.teacher: none (training target only); A2_RACE win-probability formula as a reference feature

heads.name: ts_leaf
heads.frequency: per playout leaf, bounded count per turn
